description: Display an audio using a wiki file or verified archive sources.
documentation_wikitext: Display an audio using a wiki file or verified archive sources. == Usage == {{Audio|file=Example.ogg|label=Spoken excerpt|transcript=Transcript of the excerpt.}} For an uploaded file, supply file (or positional parameter 1). MediaWiki supplies the file link and its native image or media presentation. Use ordinary [[File:...]] syntax when a reusable template is unnecessary. For a source held in an archive, omit file and supply the archive identity parameters below. Source filenames and SHA-256 values must match the archive's retained records; imports should fill these fields from verified source bindings. The storage backend does not change the template's purpose. Playback requires reader interaction. Uploaded files use TimedMediaHandler. Ordered archive sources must occupy consecutive slots.

examples.description: An OGG source followed by an MP3 fallback and a plain-text transcript.
examples.invocation:
{{Audio
| site = example-site
| label = Spoken dialogue sample
| transcript = Optional plain-text transcript.
| source1_sha256 = 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
| source1_type = ogg
| source1_filename = Dialogue sample.ogg
| source2_sha256 = fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210fedcba9876543210
| source2_type = mp3
| source2_filename = Dialogue sample.mp3
}}
